content: Close-the-loop: Canny voters auto-subscribed on vote; status change can include comment+image, posted with Notify voters; in-app bell with preview and full notifications page. Featurebase: status update with drafted message shown on the request, notification center/inbox, My profile with posts/comments/upvotes.
